what: Orient becomes a universal qualified verb — orient build, orient session, orient debug, orient task — unifying all first-move orientation acts under one name with the target as qualifier.
traces_to: Law 1 (the settled question 'how do I get my bearings on X' is answered once and named consistently) + CP4 (naming the same act with different words serves the vocabulary, not the operator)
falsifier: RED if the system still uses more than one name for the act of getting-your-bearings-before-acting. GREEN when every orientation act is named 'orient <target>' and the target is explicit.
author: Akien (idea) + CC (cast)
